novelty_flags.one_line: Replace “can remain inconclusive” and “does not give a complete per-edge classification”: the later published tree literature explicitly states that TreeID is complete on tree-shaped SCMs (although the 2022 paper did not establish that completeness proof).

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper introduces TreeID for tree-shaped SCMs, using missing bidirected cycles to obtain one or two solutions and identify instances beyond prior methods.
The paper states that TreeID is complete for tree-shaped SCMs, with completeness following from Gupta and Bläser (2024), and distinguishes its faster implementation from the prior tree algorithm.
For every tree structural parameter, Algorithm 2 decides generic identifiability, generic 2-identifiability, or generic unidentifiability; no other cases occur.
